name: Feature end to end
description: From a business idea to a ready Pull Request: refinement with the PO, technical design, implementation with tests, code review, QA and documentation, with human approvals at the milestones.
author: AI Center

inputs.name: idea
inputs.label: Idea or need
inputs.description: What the business wants to achieve and for whom

nodes.title: Refine the idea into stories
nodes.deliverable: Stories with Gherkin acceptance criteria and prioritization

nodes.title: PO approval
nodes.instructions: Check that the stories reflect the need, the acceptance criteria are complete and the scope is right.

nodes.title: Technical design
nodes.deliverable: Technical design, ADR if applicable and implementation plan

nodes.title: Validate design
nodes.instructions: Check that the design fits the architecture, is secure and the plan is realistic.

nodes.title: Implement with tests
nodes.deliverable: Code and tests on a branch, summary of changes and commit message

nodes.title: Code review
nodes.instructions: Review the implementation branch changes against the story and the design. The first line must be APPROVED or CHANGES REQUIRED.

nodes.title: Review approved?
nodes.question: Did the reviewer give the APPROVED verdict (no blocking findings)?

nodes.title: QA validation
nodes.instructions: Design the test plan, automate the priority cases and run them. Report defects.

nodes.title: Final review
nodes.instructions: Review the complete PR (code, tests, QA and documentation) before opening/merging it.

nodes.text: 💡 Run this workflow with Copilot in agent mode (/wf-feature-e2e) or from the CLI with --provider copilot so the steps work on your repository.

notes: The team's reference workflow for building a complete feature with agents and human control at the milestones.
